label_scope: Sparse source-backed positives, frozen before weight experiments. M01-M17 reuse Phase 4 text labels; M18-M21 add recipe and mixed visual/text concepts. Unlabeled results have zero gain. Query images are exact catalog images, so image matching measures corpus identity rather than generalization to user photos. Phase 10 preserves all initial comparison queries and adds explicit persona queries, frozen before rerun.

fusion.aggregation: maximum per canonical entity/modality; stable ID ties
fusion.missing_modality: renormalize active weights and report limitations
